basic_details.job_title: GPSSB Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Law degree (graduate in law) from a recognised university in India; recognised to practise law; registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India; at least 5 years as a practising advocate.
qualification.details: Qualification: At least a degree in law from a recognised university in India; Recognised to practise law; Registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India Experience: At least 5 years as a practising advocate, of which at least 3 years practising in the Gujarat High Court, OR 3 years of experience defending the government in Supreme Court / High Court cases in government departments or departmental offices. Age limit: Maximum 50 years | Other conditions: | Must be registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India Must reside at the headquarters and not leave it without permission of the authorised officer Must give e-mail and mobile number to the nodal officer, monitoring branch of the concerned District Panchayat Bound by the Gujarat Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1971

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 60,000 per month consolidated for an 11-month contract

how_to_apply: Send the application in the prescribed format (Application Form given with the notice) addressed to the Secretary, Gujarat Panchayat Seva Pasandgi Mandal, Gandhinagar.
Send it in person, by speed post or by courier so that it reaches the office by 21-11-2026.
Candidates who applied against the advertisement of 12-06-2026 must apply afresh.

content_sections.heading: GPSSB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GPSSB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: At least a degree in law from a recognised university in India; Recognised to practise law; Registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India Experience: At least 5 years as a practising advocate, of which at least 3 years practising in the Gujarat High Court, OR 3 years of experience defending the government in Supreme Court / High Court cases in government departments or departmental offices. Age limit: Maximum 50 years Other conditions: Must be registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India Must reside at the headquarters and not leave it without permission of the authorised officer Must give e-mail and mobile number to the nodal officer, monitoring branch of the concerned District Panchayat Bound by the Gujarat Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1971

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly consolidated pay; no allowances, pay commission benefits, increment, interim relief, pension, bonus, LTC, leave encashment or advance are admissible. Contract for 11 months, full time May be extended for up to two more terms of 11 months each, as per need and subject to the legal provisions on contract services Performance reviewed every three months; services may be ended with one month's notice if found unsatisfactory Must join within 7 days of receiving the appointment letter, otherwise the appointment is treated as not accepted

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GPSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GPSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Legal Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GPSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form (Arji Patrak) printed with the notice; more details on https://gpssb.gujarat.gov.in) and send it to The Secretary, Gujarat Panchayat Seva Pasandgi Mandal, Block No-2, Fifth Floor, Karmayogi Bhavan, Sector-10/A, Gandhinagar, by in person, speed post or courier, to reach by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 60,000 per month consolidated for an 11-month contract.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Law degree (graduate in law) from a recognised university in India; recognised to practise law; registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India; at least 5 years as a practising advocate.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat and the Bar Council of India. Must reside at the headquarters and not leave it without permission of the authorised officer. Must give e-mail and mobile number to the nodal officer, monitoring branch of the concerned District Panchayat. Bound by the Gujarat Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1971.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MCQ-type competitive examination and/or personal interview, depending on the number of applications received. Selection by a committee chaired by an officer not below the rank of Chairman / Secretary. Method depends on the number of applications received: MCQ-type competitive examination and/or personal interview. Selection is made by a committee headed by an officer not below the rank of Chairman / Secretary.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract for 11 months, full time. May be extended for up to two more terms of 11 months each, as per need and subject to the legal provisions on contract services. Performance reviewed every three months; services may be ended with one month's notice if found unsatisfactory.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Gandhinagar.
